nom: Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-prone skin, including one with rosacea and one managing large pores and acne, report the cleanser removes makeup and daily oil without stripping or drying their skin.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin report the cleanser leaves their face hydrated rather than tight or stripped, including in winter; one reviewer, however, found it harsh and very drying and returned it.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who is also sensitive, report the cleanser removes facial oil and leaves skin clean without over-drying, though it did not fully remove her mascara.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with a compromised or damaged skin barrier and rosacea, consistently report the cleanser is gentle, non-irritating and does not cause dryness, itchiness or breakouts; no reviewer describes an adverse reaction tied to sensitive skin.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who identifies her skin as mature reports the cleanser removed her makeup thoroughly while leaving her skin hydrated rather than tight.

concerns.dehydration: Nearly all reviewers describe the cleanser as non-drying or actively hydrating, leaving skin soft rather than tight or stripped, including in cold winter weather; one reviewer, however, found it harsh and very drying and returned it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a winter-compromised skin barrier reports the cleanser eased her redness and irritated, dry patches without causing further distress.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers, including ones with a previously damaged or compromised skin barrier, report the cleanser is the first that did not upset or further strip their barrier, with one describing her barrier as almost completely healed after two weeks of nightly use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts, including one who also used it on her teenage son's mild acne without issue; no reviewer in this set reports increased breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil effectively, leaving skin clean without a residue or oily feel.

aspects.libelle: Struggles to fully remove waterproof or long-wear makeup
Scent seen as chemical or unpleasant by some
Froths into a light, gentle lather
Small amount needed, good value per tube
Passes residue tests, nothing left behind

extraits.texte: I went in looking for the milk face wash in this brand which was discontinued. This is very harsh leaving my face very dry. Returning

this product SAVED my skin. My skin barrier was destroyed with 'sensitive skin friendly' products over the last few years and nothing fixed it until this. Using it every night for only 2 weeks it's already almost completed healed. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

extraits.titre: Gentle to the skin with compromised skin barrier
extraits.texte: As someone living in Chicago, the brutal cold and constant exposure to road salt can really take a toll on my skin. This winter, my skin barrier became severely compromised, leaving me with irritated, dry patches, redness, and a heightened sensitivity to most products. But, after trying Beekman 1802's Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover, I've finally found a product that gently addresses my skin's needs without causing further distress. The texture is smooth, almost like a soft milk, and it froths just the right amount to clean without feeling stripping. I've always been hesitant with cleansers, especially after my skin barrier damage, because many are too harsh or leave my face feeling tight and dry. This cleansing gel, however, is remarkably soothing. It effectively removes makeup and daily grime without causing any irritation. If you have extremely sensitive skin like mine, or if your skin has been compromised by harsh weather and environmental factors, I highly recommend giving Beekman 1802's Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover a try. It's a gentle, effective, and skin-loving option that won't disrupt your delicate skin barrier.

I have oily acne prone skin so I am very picky about what products I use on my face. I have large pores so I appreciate a good cleanser for removing everyday dirt and makeup as well. Most cleansers usually strip my face leaving it dry but this one cleaned my face in one round leaving it feeling refreshing and not dry. The biggest benefit is that it got rid of all my makeup while being gentle at the same time. A little goes a long way too, therefore it'll last a long time. This has earned a place on my vanity. I recommend this for all skin types, because it really is a gentle giant!

extraits.titre: I would absolutely buy this product again
extraits.texte: I usually purchase cream cleansers… However, I've been wanting to try this brand and I thought I would go ahead and try this particular cleanser… I felt the cleanser left my skin still feeling hydrated, it removed all of my facial makeup along with my eye makeup! My face did not feel dehydrated or tight at all… Which I think is a nice sign for a gel type cleanser… I would go ahead and try it …and I have mature skin.

I received Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover as complimentary from Beekman 1802. This cleanser is gentle and non-drying, which is perfect for my dry skin. It left my skin feeling soft and hydrated rather than tight or stripped, which I really appreciated. I also loved the light, fresh scent. As a makeup remover, though, it didn't seem completely effective. It worked well for removing light makeup, but it struggled with waterproof makeup products. I found myself sometimes needing to use a separate makeup remover to completely clean them.

I made the switch to all natural skincare products during 2020 and haven't deviated from my cleansing bar since then. I just haven't found a great cleansing product with clean ingredients that was able to do the job. I loved this Micellar Milk Froth from the moment I opened it. It didn't have a strong scent and was not tacky. I was able to get a good cleanse with a bare face, minimal makeup and even with a full makeup and long- lasting lipstick. I am thoroughly impressed! After cleaning, I could even feel my pores tighten. This was a feeling that I missed from my natural soap bars. Also, it didn't break me out! Which is hard to manage after so many years of using the same skincare products. I had my teenaged son who suffers from mild acne use in his skincare regimen as well. I was so excited, I even shared with my daughter in law because it was just THAT good! I'll be continuing with this product in my skincare regimen from now on.
